svg.title: Selected work
svg.desc: Things I'm building. Scolaris GO (shipping): a school management mobile app — leading architecture, milestones, code reviews and app-store delivery, with offline support and security work. TypeScript, React Native, Expo. System Analyzer (in progress): a native macOS monitoring and recovery workbench that explains system health instead of dumping raw metrics. MemonaIQ (building): an independent SaaS of focused utilities for web workflows, digital infrastructure and security. Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma. Terra Watch (concept): a trail-hazard map with confidence-aware severity that helps people choose safer routes. Next.js, MapLibre GL JS, PostGIS, Drizzle.

g.text: A calm, native workbench that explains
what your Mac is doing — not just stats.
Small, sharp utilities for web, infra
A trail-hazard map that helps people
